The Navien NPE-240A2 is a condensing tankless water heater from Navien's NPE-2 series, with the ComfortFlow® recirculation pump and buffer tank built into the cabinet. No external pump, no dedicated return line hardware to buy separately.

Rated input is 13,300 - 199,900 BTU/h on natural gas or propane — the unit is certified for both. It modulates from 199,900 BTU/h all the way down to 13,300, so it is not running at full fire to fill a sink.

How much hot water you actually get

Navien rates every tankless unit by temperature rise, because the colder the incoming water, the less of it one burner can heat. Here is what the NPE-240A2 delivers:

Temperature rise Flow rate Typical use
35°F 11.2 GPM Warm-climate groundwater, or a preheated feed
45°F 8.7 GPM The usual design point across most of the U.S.
67°F 5.6 GPM Northern winter, incoming water near 40°F

Sized against a 2.5 GPM showerhead, the 67°F column is worth roughly 2 showers at once on the coldest day of the year, and more than that the rest of the year. Size to the 67°F row if your winter groundwater runs cold.

Minimum activation flow is 0.5 GPM, so it fires for a hand wash, not just a full shower.

With a Navien recirculation setup this unit also supports the low-flow activation option, down to under 0.01 GPM.

About ComfortFlow®: the pump and the buffer tank are inside the unit, not bolted on. That is what kills the cold-water sandwich when someone turns the shower off and back on, and it lets you run recirculation on a dedicated return line or on a crossover valve at the far fixture.

Frequently asked questions

How many showers can the Navien NPE-240S2 run at once?

Navien rates the NPE-240S2 at 5.8 GPM at a 67°F temperature rise and 8.7 GPM at a 45°F rise. With 2.5 GPM showerheads that is roughly two showers at once on the coldest day of the year, and more the rest of the year.

Does the NPE-240S2 run on propane?

Yes. The unit is certified for both natural gas and propane, with a modulating input of 13,300 to 199,900 BTU/h.

What venting does the NPE-240S2 need?

Intake and exhaust run in 2" or 3" PVC, CPVC, polypropylene or stainless steel, with 0" clearance to combustibles. Gas, venting and condensate work must be done by a licensed installer to the Navien manual and local code.

What is the difference between the NPE-240S2 and the NPE-240A2?

They share the same cabinet and dual stainless steel heat exchangers. The NPE-240A2 adds an internal recirculation pump; the NPE-240S2 has no pump and carries the higher efficiency rating, 0.96 UEF.

AquaFlow AF-40 is a 40-gallon AquaFlow indirect fired water heater with a stainless steel tank and coil.

Each tank has an AISI 444 stainless steel tank with a 316L stainless heat exchanger coil, all butt-welded construction, and full internal and external pickling and passivation. No sacrificial anode is required, there is a dedicated recirculation connection, and 2" rigid polyurethane foam insulation keeps standby heat loss under half a degree per hour. The tanks are designed for use with boilers, solar and heat-recovery systems. The tank and heating coil carry a limited lifetime warranty (residential); commercial use is covered by a 6-year limited warranty, and parts by a 1-year limited warranty. This model is listed with a 120,000 BTU maximum input and a first hour rating of 216.

An indirect water heater is heated by a separate heat source, so before ordering confirm your boiler or other heat source can supply the required input, and check the drawings and submittal for connection locations and dimensions.

The Lochinvar Noble NKC110N is a wall-mounted, gas-fired fire tube combi boiler for natural gas. It provides both space heating and domestic hot water from one residential appliance, with an input range of 11,000 to 110,000 BTU/h (10:1 turndown), 95% AFUE and the SMART CONTROL operating system.

Before ordering, confirm the fuel: NKC110N is natural gas, and NKC110L is the propane model. Size hot water demand against the rating of up to 2.6 GPM at a 77°F temperature rise; the larger Noble combi models are 150,000 and 199,000 BTU/h. Plan the direct vent run on 3 in. flue in PVC, CPVC, polypropylene or stainless steel per the Lochinvar manual, and allow for the 44.25 in. height on the wall. For hydro-air systems, the air handler interlock prevents cool air circulation while the boiler is making hot water.
